explicit_user_authorization: 保留现有公开仓库并公开发布全部结果
git_scope: Phase-two source and necessary deployment dependency, tests, protocols and human-readable final reports; unrelated existing phase-one working changes excluded.
release_scope: All inventoried phase-two learning/development/frozen evaluation, independent truth and review evidence, failures, timeouts and deviations, plus explicitly inventoried runtime management evidence.
private_path_meaning: Learner visibility during the experiment; not a blanket public-release exclusion. Future learner input allowlists remain unchanged.
authentication_treatment: Redact authentication values in separate exports; retain original and export SHA256 and explicit treatment. Do not read or hash excluded credential stores.
image_check_limit: Byte-pattern scanning; no claim of exhaustive OCR.
evidence_asset_format: Independent ZIP volumes, target 512 MiB each; complete portable paths and SHA256 indexes.
publication_gate: Independent export audit, approved manifest binding, full ZIP member verification, exact repository/account/commit, complete remote asset size and SHA256 verification.
